# Emily Cruz

> Actor-musician and artist (she/her). BA (Hons) Actor-Musician, Guildford School of Acting, 2023 to 2026. Based in Greater London. Represented by Galloways.

Facts from Emily's Spotlight profile, as supplied on 20 November 2026. Please keep dates with facts.

## Now

- As of November 2026: UK tour of Pride and Prejudice* *(sort of), 1st Cover: Effie, Flo, Tillie (director Isobel McArthur; company David Pugh).

- 2026: Pride and Prejudice* *(sort of) (Stage, UK tour). Role: 1st Cover: Effie, Flo, Tillie. Director: Isobel McArthur. Company: David Pugh.

## Training

- Guildford School of Acting, BA (Hons) Actor-Musician, 3 years, 2023 to 2026.

## Skills

- Music: Alto (voice), Piano, Accordion, Guitar, Bass guitar, Double bass, Alto saxophone, Tenor saxophone, Musical director.
- Dance: Commercial, Jazz, Tap, Hip hop.
- Accents and dialects: Standard English, RP, Heightened RP, Cockney, West Country, Northern Irish, American: East Coast, American: New York, American: Southern States, Portuguese, Spanish.
- Languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish.
- Performance: Actor-musician, Laban training.
- Other: Painting, Crochet, Knitting, Cycling, Field hockey, Football, Netball, Swimming, Car driving licence.

## Details

- Height: 5 ft 5 in (165 cm).
- Hair: Light/mid brown, mid length.
- Eyes: Hazel.
- Nationalities: British, Portuguese.
